video.title: Jim Rohn: Why Not You, Why Not Now

motivational.video_read: This is Jim Rohn on stage at a Herbalife 'Extravaganza', delivering his famous four-questions talk: why, why not, why not you, why not now. The motivational material lives exactly in those question builds — the 'why not you' passage is the most-commented moment in the video, and the audience quotes the 'why/how' and 'without a vision' lines verbatim. Herbalife product pitches thread through and contaminate several stretches (especially the 'why not now' build), which I have worked around rather than through.

near_misses.why_not: The 'why pay the price, why work this hard' roll is genuinely strong but runs ~95 seconds to its landing ('you're the only one that can answer that question for yourself'), and its best quotable payoff is already captured in the L0014-L0016 clip.

'If a farm boy can wander out of Idaho... why not you' is a good reframe, but it leans on Extravaganza and 'Mar Hughes' references a stranger can't read, and it duplicates the stronger 'why not you' clip at L0049.

The 'why not now' question itself is one of the famous four, but the moment it opens it collapses into a Herbalife mountain-top recap ('Barcelona was special, Orlando was outrageous') — unusable around the question.

skipped.what: movie testimony ('we joined because we believed, we left because we were disillusioned') — context-dependent, no turn for the viewer
dream-strategy setup that becomes a Herbalife product pitch ('herbal life has got the ability to make it all come true')
Rohn's own goals dated to the year 2000 — someone else's résumé, dated and unusable
warm 'I wish I could sit with each of you' passage — affection, not motivation
'I'll walk with you as we take Herbal Life around the world' — sponsor pledge

clips.title: Why not you?
clips.why: The heart of the video and its most-marked moment (29 and 26 like comments on this exact second). Rohn turns a vague dream into a direct personal confrontation: 'you've got the brains, you can make decisions, you can change your life, you can build a financial wall around your family nothing can get through' — then lands 'why not you' twice. It removes the viewer's quiet excuse that they are somehow not the kind of person things happen to. Viewers literally wrote 'I will come back to this a lot' on this second. Note: L0049 opens mid-sentence ('do it from up here'); a cleaner edge is 'you've got the brains' at L0050, and the hook line 'my personal question to you is why not you' can be flashed from L0049.

clips.title: If the why is powerful, the how is easy
clips.why: Two separate quotable lines delivered back to back: the mechanism ('if the why is powerful the how is easy') and the warning ('without a vision we die, without a vision we perish, without a dream we're nothing'). Both lines are quoted word-for-word in the audience's comments — one at 93 likes saying they have listened to this speech over 100 times. The first line hands the viewer a way to think about their own stuckness; the second makes the absence of a dream feel existential. Under 22 seconds total, and either line can be flashed at the head of the reel.

clips.title: Why not see what kind of person you can become
clips.why: A permission roll: 'why not see how much you can earn, why not see how much you can learn, why not see what kind of person you can become.' It takes away the assumption that wanting more needs justification — the 'why not' is the whole argument. This is the second of Rohn's four questions and the audience's loudest comment theme ('why not me? why not now? the 4 most important questions I have ever been asked', 129 likes) lives here. Cutting note: L0029 opens with meta framing ('here's number two') and L0031 ends mid-phrase — the editor should trim to 'why not see how much you can earn... why not see how many people you can reach', pulling 'can reach' from the top of L0032.

clips.title: Breathe into it your own personal spirit until it becomes a flame
clips.why: The 'why not now' payoff: 'take this dream and not let it die, take this dream and give it life, take this dream and breathe into it your own personal Spirit until finally it becomes a flame that burns around the whole world — let's go do it now.' Pure rally-cry rhythm with an instruction sized to tonight: start now. Returned despite real worries: the surrounding build (L0055-L0059) is Herbalife/Extravaganza recap the clip must avoid, and L0060 opens mid-thought — the second pass should cut in at 'take this dream and not let it die' mid-line. If that edge can't be made clean, this is droppable.
